description: §14.8.9 S443 round 6 (L1) — a callback handed to a call the compiler has no model for (here `String.prototype.replace`) receives the protected value; what it stores escapes. E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: §14.8.9 (S441 amendment): "Provenance is preserved by default. Any step not positively known to produce a value of independent identity preserves it" and "Unresolvable callees fail closed." A callback's parameters were bound clean, so `u.passwordHash.replace(/.+/, m => { seen = m })` then `return seen` served the hash over HTTP (measured, S443 round 6). The callback of an unmodelled call now receives the join of the receiver and every argument.
